from.place: Step 2: kernels and cokernels of maps between finite modules over a Noetherian ring are finite

title: Finite modules are closed under kernels and cokernels over a Noetherian ring
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $f:M\to N$ be an $A$-linear map between finitely generated $A$-modules [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then $\ker(f)$ and $\operatorname{coker}(f)$ are finitely generated $A$-modules.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line per clause: for the kernel apply Module.Finite.of_injective (Mathlib/RingTheory/Noetherian/Basic.lean:136-139) to (LinearMap.ker f).subtype, whose injectivity is the injectivity of subtype inclusion; its IsNoetherian A M hypothesis is inferred by isNoetherian_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite (same file:324-328). For the cokernel N / LinearMap.range f apply Module.Finite.quotient (Mathlib/RingTheory/Finiteness/Basic.lean:264-267), specializing both scalar rings to A and the ambient module to N; the self scalar tower is canonical. This clause needs only Module.Finite A N. No finite-cardinality assumption is used.
